brief:
Israel warned Hamas it would intensify strikes in Gaza if drones, balloons, and kites continue to be launched from the Strip toward Israeli settlements, Middle East Eye reported. The threat comes as cross-border aerial launches have persisted despite previous Israeli military responses. Netanyahu's office issued the warning but did not specify the scale or nature of any escalation or provide a timeline for implementation.

The warning signals potential for further displacement of Palestinians as tensions escalate over the launching campaigns. Israel has previously conducted military operations in Gaza in response to such incidents, resulting in civilian casualties and forced displacement. The latest threat underscores the cycle of escalation tied to aerial launches from Palestinian territory.

title: Israel threatens intensified Gaza strikes over kite launches
